name: chldidel_next
label: Ideal number of children - follow-on version

questions.text:
What do you think is the ideal number of children for a family to have? 
 NOTE: This variable originates on the GSS Next follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the GSS Next-specific weights WTSSPS_NEXT or WTSSNRPS_NEXT

name: chldpref_next
label: R ideal number of children - follow-on version

questions.text:
For you personally, what is the ideal number of children you would like to have or would have liked to have had? 
 NOTE: This variable originates on the GSS Next follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the GSS Next-specific weights WTSSPS_NEXT or WTSSNRPS_NEXT

How old were you when your first child was born? 
 As of 2024, AGEKDBRN has been recoded to only account for first child born during ages 18-45. This has been retroactively applied to all previous years of AGEKDBRN. The original AGEKDBRN containing data from 1994 to 2022 has been renamed AGEKDBRN_9422.
